title: The outer halo globular cluster system of M31 - III. Relationship to the stellar halo

evidence.locator: Sect. 3.1 and Fig. 4: the radial surface density of M31's globular clusters breaks at a projected radius of about 27 kpc; a least-squares fit to all points outside 25 kpc gives a power law of index -2.37 +/- 0.17, out to about 150 kpc (-2.15 +/- 0.10 without the bump at 30 to 50 kpc). Footnote 5: the halo outside 25 kpc appears close to spherical.
